eventDetail.scope: ICIIS 2026 covers a wide range of engineering disciplines, with added focus on sustainability and trustworthiness. The conference is being organised to function as a platform for dissemination of recent high-quality research work. It covers the wide domain of Computer Science, Electronics, and Electrical Engineering and will provide a means to exchange innovative ideas and recent advances among researchers from academia and industry.
